# 4. About Us: [About FinanceChk — Why We Build Free Financial Tools](https://financechk.com/about)
#    - Description: Information about the FinanceChk website and its purpose.

# Purpose of the site: To provide free, accurate, and easy-to-use financial tools and educational content to help users make informed financial decisions in India. The site covers a wide range of personal finance topics, including loans, investments, taxes, and trading. The calculators are designed to be user-friendly and provide detailed results, while the blog offers in-depth analysis and guidance on various financial topics.
